title: Speculation that Kirkpatrick was read into the legacy program

tellings.quote: and you know there's speculation that he was uh read into the legacy program and

plain: Sean Kirkpatrick, the first head of the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to study unexplained aerial reports, was speculated to have been "read into" the legacy program, meaning he was given access to it. The legacy program is a long-running secret effort that some claim handles recovered non-human craft. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, mentions the speculation in passing. If true, it would mean the man running the public inquiry knew about the secret effort.
